<issue>
Version property gets reversed when set

#### Description

When setting the version property on CorePropertiesPart, the string value gets reversed unexpectedly.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx.parts.coreprops import CorePropertiesPart
from pptx.oxml.coreprops import CT_CoreProperties

# Create a core properties part
coreProperties = CT_CoreProperties.new()
core_properties = CorePropertiesPart.load(None, None, None, coreProperties)

# Set version property
core_properties.version = "81.2.8"

# Check the actual value stored
print(f"Expected: 81.2.8")
print(f"Actual: {core_properties.version}")
```

Expected output:
```
Expected: 81.2.8
Actual: 81.2.8
```

Actual output:
```
Expected: 81.2.8
Actual: 8.2.18
```

The version string is being reversed when set, which breaks document metadata handling.
</issue>
